thought.text: Let me instrument `_install_module_batch` temporarily to log the exact module groups, then re-run install.

action.command:
cd /workspace
cp web/core/includes/install.core.inc /tmp/install.core.inc.bak
sed -i 's|^function _install_module_batch(array $modules, array $module_names, array &\$context): void {$|function _install_module_batch(array $modules, array $module_names, array \&$context): void {\n  file_put_contents("/tmp/batch_debug.log", json_encode($modules) . "\\n", FILE_APPEND);|' web/core/includes/install.core.inc
sed -n '1936,1940p' web/core/includes/install.core.inc
